partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Adverse-phenotype-gated top-three causal-module coverage
results.hypothesis: Broad top-three causal-module coverage improves when direct adverse disease evidence and exact SIDER phenotype mimicry are both excluded.
results.body: R250 excluding exact drug-side-effect and disease-phenotype overlap
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule retains multi-target disease-relative coverage while vetoing direct and phenotype-level graph-native adverse evidence.
results.trapi_notes: The positive and adverse motifs are TRAPI-expressible; negative existential logic, rank, cardinality, phenotype identity, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)

WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:CONTRAINDICATED_IN|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|CAUSES]->(object)
  }

  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(:PhenotypicFeature)
          <-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]-(object)
  }

WITH subject, object, count(DISTINCT gene) AS targeted_genes
WHERE targeted_genes >= 2
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
